text:
Sofia L.: ACME asked for a short, low-friction POC (3 weeks) but legal is pushing hard on key control and EU-only residency. Need a recommended hosting path and a compact commercial table for Monday.

Ben T.: Quick summary from presales call: baseline 60 req/s, burst to ~250 req/s, want p95 <450ms and request audit logs for 45 days during the test. Legal will likely ask for BYOK or VPC.

Aisha R.: From eng: Hosted can be routed to EU and we can pin model/version quickly. BYOK on Hosted is not standard; we can offer a workaround (encryption boundary + DPA) for a short POC but not customer KMS. Dedicated supports BYOK in many cases and gives isolation; Private gives full control but long lead time.

Contracts: For commercial: customer wants price delta for POC vs Dedicated pilot month and statement on return of logs/retention policy. Also asking for minimal legal wording to get started (temp DPA language).

InfraBot: Rough cost/time for a 3-week POC:
```
- Hosted (EU tenant): <24h, est $4.5k (usage + infra)
- Dedicated (small reserved pool): 2-4 business days if capacity, est $16k + commit
- Private (VPC/on-prem): 2-4 weeks, est $40k + PS
```
Note: Dedicated lead time depends on queue; I'll check capacity tomorrow.

Sofia L.: Proposed POC success metrics to share with ACME (short and concrete):
```
1) Accuracy: >= 90% pass on buyer QA for 250 sampled prompts
2) Latency: p95 < 450ms in EU during normal traffic
3) Throughput: sustain 60 req/s for 15min windows without errors
4) Logs: retention 45 days, searchable; audit trail present
5) Security: "must" SSQ items addressed (KMS, encryption, region)
```
Will send these as a checklist.

Ben T.: Eval plan: 3 buckets (core intents, malformed/paraphrase, safety). Run automated metrics + 250 human labels. We'll include sample prompts to show coverage.

Aisha R.: Risks + mitigations to include in the one-pager:
- If legal requires BYOK and Dedicated capacity isn't available quickly -> fallback = Hosted with documented DPA + limited data flow and escalate to Dedicated as soon as capacity frees.
- If p95 regresses during tests -> auto-scale + notify ACME + short model fallback.

Contracts: I'll draft minimal starter DPA language and a line about log handling. Also flag that Hosted with temporary DPA is legal-acceptable for limited POC in many deals but needs exec sign-off.

Sofia L.: Action items:
- Contracts: draft DPA + log clause (owner) - due Thu EOD
- InfraBot / Aisha: confirm Dedicated capacity + BYOK feasibility (owner) - due Wed
- Ben: prompt buckets + 250-sample human eval plan (owner) - due Wed
- Sofia: assemble one-pager (commercial table + success metrics + rollback play) - will circulate Fri morning

InfraBot: Confirming I'll run a capacity check and post ETA. If Dedicated is limited, note expected extra 5-7 business days.

Sofia L.: OK. We'll present Hosted-first + Dedicated as upgrade path, Private only if legal mandates and budget allows. Keep messaging focused on speed + mitigations. Thanks :white_check_mark:
